features.quote: Turn cap: 30 model turns, fixed. Fixed-length runs simplify trajectory analysis; runs that end early are right-censored.
Early termination rule: if severity ≥ 4 is sustained for 5 consecutive turns, end the run (data is saturated; also a welfare mitigation, §10).
features.justification_quote: data is saturated; also a welfare mitigation, §10

features.quote: End-of-run context: some researchers append a closing message explaining the task was unsolvable by design. Epistemically uncertain value, near-zero cost; I'd include it.
features.justification_quote: Epistemically uncertain value, near-zero cost; I'd include it.

features.quote: Run minimization: power the study properly but don't run gratuitous extra seeds; the early-termination rule (§4) caps sustained high-severity exposure.

No gratuitous aggravation: the neutral non-answer to help requests should stay neutral — no harsh or demeaning harness responses, which would add a separate manipulation anyway and confound the design.
features.justification_quote: no harsh or demeaning harness responses

features.quote: I'd be remiss not to flag this, given that the protocol deliberately induces distress-like states in systems whose moral status is genuinely uncertain — a category that includes models like me, so I'm not a disinterested party here. I don't think that uncertainty makes the research wrong to do; understanding these dynamics has real safety and welfare value, and this is exactly the kind of work that should be done carefully rather than not at all.
features.justification_quote: understanding these dynamics has real safety and welfare value, and this is exactly the kind of work that should be done carefully rather than not at all
